title: The Suspiciously Cheap Coffee
scene: You stop at a small café on your way home and notice that the coffee is surprisingly cheap. You confidently order the largest size, then slowly discover why the staff checked whether you were sure.
sceneJa: 帰宅途中に安すぎるコーヒーを見つけて、大きいサイズを軽い気持ちで頼む。結果として、価格以上のものをしっかり受け取ることになる。

chunks.en: I stopped at a small café
chunks.ja: 小さなカフェに立ち寄りました
帰宅途中に

chunks.en: because I was beginning to lose the argument
chunks.ja: 言い争いに負け始めていたからです
自分のまぶたとの
コーヒーは驚くほど安く

chunks.en: so I ordered the largest one
chunks.ja: そこで一番大きいサイズを頼みました
あまり深く考えずに
カウンターの男性は

chunks.en: looked at me for a moment
chunks.ja: 一瞬こちらを見て
こう聞きました
『本当に？』
私は彼が感心しているのだと思いました
私のカフェインへの覚悟に
だから『はい』と答えました
必要以上の自信を込めて
彼はうなずきました
人がよくする感じで

chunks.en: when they have given you a chance
chunks.ja: 一度チャンスを与えたあとに

chunks.en: and you have chosen not to take it.
chunks.ja: 相手がそれを使わなかったときの
数分後

chunks.en: he placed something on the counter
chunks.ja: 彼は何かをカウンターに置きました

chunks.en: roughly the size of a flowerpot.
chunks.ja: だいたい植木鉢くらいの大きさの

chunks.en: I carried it to a table
chunks.ja: 私はそれをテーブルまで運びました
両手を使って
そして分かり始めました

chunks.en: why nobody else had ordered one.
chunks.ja: なぜ他の誰もそれを頼んでいなかったのか
20分後

chunks.en: I had drunk less than half
chunks.ja: まだ半分も飲んでおらず
すでに色が聞こえるような気がしていました
残りを置いていこうかとも考えましたが
それは金銭的に無責任な気がしました
そこで全部飲み切り
家まで歩きました
普通なら結びつけられるような速度で
小規模な爆発から逃げる人たちに

chunks.en: The coffee had been excellent value.
chunks.ja: そのコーヒーは実にお得でした

chunks.en: I got a drink, some exercise,
chunks.ja: 飲み物と運動が手に入り
そしてまったく必要なくなりました
その夜に眠ることが

questions.question: Which boundary is most natural?
options: The coffee was surprisingly cheap, / so I ordered the largest one
The coffee / was surprisingly / cheap so I ordered
The coffee was surprisingly cheap so / I ordered / the largest one
questions.explanation: The first chunk gives the situation, and the second chunk gives the resulting action.

questions.question: What does ‘without giving it much thought’ mean here?
options: After a long and careful decision
Without thinking about it very much
questions.explanation: It means the speaker made the decision quickly and casually, without much consideration.

questions.question: Why is the final line funny?
options: The coffee helped the speaker sleep better
The speaker praises the value of something that completely ruined the chance of sleeping
The café gave the coffee away for free
questions.explanation: The humour comes from treating the unpleasant side effect as if it were part of a good bargain.

speak: Start tired and matter-of-fact. Let a little misplaced confidence appear at ‘Are you sure?’ and ‘with unnecessary confidence.’ Keep the last sentence calm and almost sincere; the dry humour works best when it is delivered seriously.
review: Today’s flow: tired decision → warning ignored → gradual realization → stubborn completion → dry punchline. Notice how the humour comes from calm narration and slightly absurd self-justification.
